news.headline: Delcath Systems (NASDAQ:DCTH) Sets New 52-Week High – What's Next?
news.summary: DCTH shares touched a new 52-week high of $17.42 in mid-day trading in mid-August, extending the post-earnings rally after the raised FY2026 guidance. The move followed a string of bullish analyst commentary tied to accelerating HEPZATO KIT volume growth.

news.headline: Delcath Systems to Participate at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath management presented at the Canaccord Genuity Growth Conference in Boston on August 11, 2026, discussing HEPZATO KIT's commercial ramp and the company's pipeline expansion strategy with investors.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Highlights
news.summary: Delcath reported Q2 2026 total revenue of $29.1M (up ~20% YoY) with HEPZATO KIT revenue of $27.1M, 90% gross margin, and $95.9M in cash with no debt; the company raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M on ~30% HEPZATO volume growth and plans to expand from 31 to roughly 37 active treatment centers by year-end.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Remains Bullish on Delcath Systems (DCTH)
news.summary: Analyst Swayampakula Ramakanth reiterated a Buy rating and raised his price target to $32 from $30 following the Q2 beat, citing strong HEPZATO adoption and continued treatment-center activation as drivers of durable revenue growth.

news.headline: Delcath Systems, Inc. Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Delcath granted 17,000 restricted stock units to four newly hired employees as part of its continued workforce build-out to support HEPZATO KIT's commercial expansion.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 Clinical Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: The first patient was dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in the global, randomized DELUMA trial (~90 patients, 20+ sites), which evaluates HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer.

catalysts.label: Treatment center network expansion
catalysts.detail: Delcath plans to grow its active HEPZATO KIT treatment center network from 31 (as of Q2 2026) to roughly 37 centers by year-end, a key driver behind the raised FY2026 revenue guidance.

catalysts.label: HEPZATO KIT revenue guidance execution
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for full-year 2026 revenue of $104M-$108M, implying at least ~28% HEPZATO KIT volume growth over 2025; quarterly prints through year-end will test execution against this raised bar.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings call
catalysts.detail: Delcath's next quarterly results and business update; exact date not yet announced as of late August 2026.

catalysts.label: DELUMA trial enrollment (metastatic breast cancer)
catalysts.detail: Following the first patient dosed in July 2026, the ~90-patient randomized Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO plus standard of care in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer continues enrolling across 20+ US/Europe sites; full enrollment and topline timing not yet disclosed.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) trial readout
catalysts.detail: Randomized Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO plus trifluridine-tipiracil/bevacizumab in liver-dominant mCRC; hepatic progression-free survival (primary endpoint) data expected mid-2028, with overall survival (secondary endpoint) expected late 2028.

catalysts.label: Broader label-expansion data / larger addressable markets
catalysts.detail: Analysts flag that meaningful readouts from the colorectal and breast cancer expansion programs -- which would open substantially larger patient populations beyond uveal melanoma -- are unlikely before late 2027 at the earliest.

pulse: Delcath's commercial ramp for HEPZATO KIT in metastatic uveal melanoma remains the core story: Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1M (+20% YoY) and 90% gross margins pushed management to raise FY2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M, and shares rallied to a new 52-week high near $17.42 in mid-August (since easing back into the $16-17 range) on continued bullish analyst commentary (H.C. Wainwright PT raised to $32). With $95.9M in cash, no debt, and the treatment-center network expanding toward ~37 sites by year-end, the near-term outlook is largely execution-driven, while the longer-term opportunity now hinges on newly dosed label-expansion trials in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer (DELUMA) and colorectal cancer, whose pivotal data are not expected until 2027-2028.
